### Summary of Changes

1. **Fix `IndexError` on short inputs in [`is_mostly_bin`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/utils/strutils.py#L128-L163)** ([strutils.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/utils/strutils.py)):
   - When checking the boundary around ~100 bytes to avoid splitting multibyte UTF-8 code points in half, `range(100, 104)` attempted to index `s[cut]` without checking if `cut` was within bounds.
   - For inputs of length 101, 102, or 103 where byte 100 was a UTF-8 continuation byte, `s[cut]` exceeded `len(s) - 1`, raising an `IndexError`.
   - Updated the scan to `range(100, min(104, len(s)))` so indexing stops at `len(s)`.
   - Updated the loop's `else:` branch to only fallback to `s = s[:100]` if `len(s) >= 104`. For inputs with `len(s) < 104` that end with continuation bytes, the string is kept intact rather than sliced in half, preserving valid UTF-8 sequences.

2. **Add test cases in [`test_is_mostly_bin`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/utils/test_strutils.py#L82-L106)** ([test_strutils.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/utils/test_strutils.py)):
   - Added test cases with 25 4-byte UTF-8 characters shifted across the 100-character boundary (`len` 100–105) to verify that short multibyte inputs no longer raise `IndexError` and are correctly recognized as text.
   - Added binary test case `101 * b"\x80"` to verify that short binary inputs also avoid `IndexError` and are recognized as binary.
